bull_bear.body:
- Mandatory corporate-governance provisions of SEBI LODR (Regulations 17 to 27) are not applicable to the Company — The Company discloses that it does not exceed the prescribed paid-up equity share capital and net-worth thresholds under Regulation 15(2)(a), and has informed the Stock Exchange of the non-applicability; it complies only voluntarily, 'to the extent considered appropriate and practicable', so the governance framework is not mandatorily enforced.
- Repeated turnover in the Chief Financial Officer position — Three CFO changes across a short span: Mr. Vishwanatha Mahalingam resigned with effect from January 6, 2026; Mr. Deep Kumar Sharma was appointed January 10, 2026 and resigned with effect from May 30, 2026; Mr. Sushil Gambhir was appointed with effect from June 1, 2026 — continuity risk in the finance function.

The notes to the financial statements disclose a long-standing tax matter: in FY2019-20 an income-tax refund receivable in respect of assessment years 1994-95 and 1995-96 was charged to profit and loss on an opinion that the refund claim from the department is not maintainable.
